text: Two cars stand at the kerb by the bus stop for the whole clip while traffic passes them, and are reported as stopped_vehicle. That fits the definition literally; whether the annotators count a car waiting at a bus stop is the open question, to be settled with dev labels.

Jaywalker #1 is caught, but only after the traced carriageway was added: the carriageway learned from 20 s of a red phase did not yet cover the middle of the intersection. Short clips depend on the traced mask.
A car waits on the right-hand crossing for about 15 s while people walk around it. No rule fires; it is yielding, but a longer wait would become a stopped_vehicle.
